content: The service IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall enable the IdsM to modify the reporting mode IdsMReport- ingModeFilter of a specific SEv . This service shall trigger the routine execution to modify the current reporting mode, and shall contain the new reporting mode value to be set.
